scenarios.name: Strait of Hormuz Full Closure
scenarios.description: Iran deploys naval mines and fast-attack craft across the Strait of Hormuz. Lloyd's of London suspends all transit insurance. 21 million BPD of crude flow halted.

scenarios.name: Red Sea Houthi Escalation
scenarios.description: Houthi forces launch coordinated anti-ship missile strikes on commercial tankers transiting Bab el-Mandeb. Multiple vessels hit. All carriers reroute via Cape of Good Hope.

scenarios.name: Simultaneous Hormuz + Suez Blockade (Doomsday)
scenarios.description: Coordinated geopolitical crisis: Iran closes Hormuz while Houthi forces blockade Bab el-Mandeb and Suez Canal simultaneously. India loses access to 65% of its crude import corridors.

scenarios.name: Russian Oil Embargo Expansion
scenarios.description: G7 nations impose a complete maritime insurance ban on Russian crude exports. India's discounted Russian crude supply (40% of imports) halted overnight.

scenarios.name: Iran Sanctions Maximum Pressure
scenarios.description: US reimplements maximum pressure sanctions on Iranian crude exports with secondary sanctions on Indian refiners processing Iranian oil. Kharg Island exports drop to zero.
